title: Use dashboards to check a system's health

blocks.content: A dashboard is a saved page of panels: one place to check whether a system is healthy. In Grafana Cloud, that's often the first thing you open. No query to write, nothing to rebuild. The one you'll open is a demo wind farm: power produced, turbine speed, and wind, all on the same page, updating as you watch.
To open a dashboard, complete the following steps:
Click **Dashboards** in the main menu. This page lists every saved dashboard, grouped in folders.
Open **Demo Wind Farm**, one of the dashboards in the **Examples** folder. It watches a small wind farm: power produced, turbine speed, and wind.
You opened a saved dashboard from the dashboard list. No setup, just a click.
Next, read the dashboard and try its controls:

blocks.reftarget: [data-testid='data-testid Panel header Wind Farm - Total Average Power (Watts)']
blocks.content: Each rectangle is a **panel**: one view of the data. This chart tracks the farm's power output over time. Others on the page show single numbers, like **Current Power**.
blocks.tooltip: One view of the data. A dashboard is a saved page of these.

blocks.content: Each panel has a menu that lets you view, share, or inspect just that panel. It hides in the panel's top-right corner until your mouse is over the panel. Watch **Current Power**: the menu opens.

steps.tooltip: This panel, like every panel, keeps a menu in its top-right corner.
The menu lives here. **View**, **Share**, and **Inspect** give you a closer look at this one panel.

blocks.content: The **time range** at the top right sets the window of time the whole page shows. Open it and choose **Last 1 hour**, then watch: every panel on the page redraws to the new window at once.

steps.tooltip: The window of time the whole page is showing. Every panel follows it.

steps.reftarget: [data-testid='data-testid TimePicker time range option now-1h to now'] label
steps.tooltip: One change here redraws every panel on the page for the new window of time.

blocks.content: Change the time range once and every panel follows. That's enough to read almost any dashboard you meet in Grafana Cloud.
